rows.buildingDesc: The Home Hall is the hub of your Home. Upgrading it unlocks more buildings and raises their level caps. Assign a character to the Hall to let friends rent them.
The War Room is your Home's command center. Both defending and raiding are carried out through the War Room. Raiding other players yields precious Essence.

rows.buildingDesc: The Vault protects your Essence. When your Home is raided, the Vault shields your Essence and reduces how much is stolen.
The Dormitory is where characters recover stamina. Place a character here to slowly restore their stamina.
The Essence Collector produces Essence, the raw material used to produce other items. Upgrading it lets you gather Essence faster.
The Blue Diamond Workshop is a production building that produces Blue Diamonds. Upgrading it yields more Blue Diamonds.

uncertain_notes: TableHomeHeroSkill/skillId 98: source text is '附魂殿生产搜魂券' using 搜魂券 ('soul-search voucher'), different characters from 附魂卷/附魂券 (Soul-Enchant Scroll) used in TableHomeBuildingType id 11 and most other Soul-Enchant skills/formulaType 10. Possibly a data typo for the same item, or a genuinely separate item. Translated literally as 'Soul-Search Voucher' pending confirmation.

TableHomeBuildingType/id 11 buildingDesc uses 附魂券 ('voucher/ticket', quan) while TableHomeBuildingProduceFormulaType/formulaType 10 and most TableHomeHeroSkill rows use 附魂卷 ('scroll', juan) for what appears to be the same produced item. Treated as one item and translated consistently as 'Soul-Enchant Scroll' throughout; flagging the underlying source inconsistency in case they are meant to be distinct items.

TableHomeHeroSkill: several skill tiers reuse the same skillName at a higher/lower % than expected, or repeat out of numeral order. This looks like an inconsistency in the original source naming/tiering, not a translation choice - names were translated verbatim as given without renumbering.
TableHomeProsperity/id 4 '自然之力' -> resDes '属性伤害+5%': translated as 'Elemental Damage'; could alternatively mean generic 'stat damage'.
TableHomeProsperity/id 7 '神力' -> resDes '坚韧攻击+3000、坚韧防御+3000': translated literally as 'Tenacity Attack'/'Tenacity Defense'; exact established in-game stat name not confirmable from context alone.
TableHomeBuildingProduceFormulaType/formulaType 6 '精金锭': translated as 'Refined Gold Ingot'; some localizations render 精金 as a fantasy metal name (e.g. 'Mithril') instead.
TableHomeLandDressGrid/dressGridId 12 '神迹': translated as 'Miracle'; 'Relic' or 'Divine Wonder' are plausible alternates.
